sources.title: Claude's June 15 billing change — cancelled before it took effect — AI ...
sources.snippet: In brief Anthropic planned to move programmatic usage (Agent SDK, `claude -p`, Code GitHub Actions, third-party agent apps) off subscription limits and onto a separate metered credit on June 15, 2026. On June 15, it cancelled the change. Nothing changes for now: those surfaces still draw from your Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise limits exactly as before. Here's the full story, why it matters ...
